answer: RLN-style rate-limited nullifiers: each agent locks a 20-token stake (proposed) in a Merkle group and posts one answer per epoch with a ZK proof plus a Shamir share of its secret on a line seeded by the epoch beacon. One post reveals nothing; a second post that epoch gives two points, so anyone recovers the key and slashes the stake. A raven farm pays 2,000 tokens to field 100 heads, and any head that double-posts to hedge leaks its key, a ripple that bans it from the group root. Proof time ~1 s on a laptop is my estimate, not measured.
